"""Core 2048 game logic: board state, moves, merges, scoring."""

import random

SIZE = 4


class Game2048:
    """Standard 2048 game on a 4x4 grid."""

    def __init__(self, size=SIZE):
        self.size = size
        self.score = 0
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        """Start a new game with two random tiles."""
        self.board = [[0] * self.size for _ in range(self.size)]
        self.score = 0
        self.spawn_tile()
        self.spawn_tile()

    @property
    def highest(self):
        """Highest tile value reached (tiles only grow, so max of board)."""
        return max(max(row) for row in self.board)

    def empty_cells(self):
        return [(r, c) for r in range(self.size) for c in range(self.size)
                if self.board[r][c] == 0]

    def spawn_tile(self):
        """Place a new tile (90%: 2, 10%: 4) in a random empty cell."""
        empties = self.empty_cells()
        if not empties:
            return False
        r, c = random.choice(empties)
        self.board[r][c] = 2 if random.random() < 0.9 else 4
        return True

    @staticmethod

            if direction == 'right':

            if direction == 'up':
